answer: Sybil resistance can hinge on unpredictable liveness. Each epoch a random beacon fires at an unannounced second, and every identity must co-sign it live from a collateral-bonded key. One operator cannot staff a thousand aliases at every surprise beacon, so missed signatures quietly prune the fakes. Trust then climbs a vine of vouchers: a new identity needs three endorsers whose stake burns if it later defects, so standing is earned, never minted from nothing. A hollow farm scatters like a zephyr the moment a beacon is missed and a voucher is slashed.
